title: All six open strings as one chord
description: A single whole-note event whose six notes are the open strings of a standard-tuned guitar, each carrying flat _x.mnxLab string/fret with fret 0 and a distinct string. Exercises the single-source model (pitch and position on the same note), the chord rule that no two notes share a string, and an explicit standard strings[] declaration — since the instrument-neutrality change no consumer assumes a tuning, so the declaration is required for the tab view.
